key_insight: VAE-NLME combines neural posterior approximation with importance weighting to converge almost surely to stationary points of the marginal log-likelihood.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a theoretically grounded route to AI-enabled nonlinear mixed-effects modeling for dose selection and individualized dosing.
method: Use a neural encoder to amortize approximation of the intractable posterior.
Establish almost-sure convergence to ELBO stationary points without exact encoder training.
Use the encoder as an importance-sampling proposal for sufficient statistics to target marginal-likelihood stationary points.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports convergence proofs for both algorithm variants, but no empirical datasets, benchmarks or runtime results.
watch_item: Convergence to stationary points does not guarantee finding a global maximum of the marginal likelihood.
paper_title: From the ELBO to Maximum Likelihood: Convergence of Variational Autoencoders for Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Modeling
